faq.2.answer: Yes. Coloring PRO supports Apple Pencil and S Pen: stroke width responds to pressure. You can also draw with your finger.

faq.3.answer: That's exactly why contours exist. The lines already define the shape — you just choose colors and fill it with mood.
faq.3.question: What if I can't draw?
faq.4.answer: Of course. It exports as a PNG with the contour on a white background — save it to your device gallery or share it through any app.
faq.4.question: Can I save my finished work?

onboarding.slide.01.text: Here you color the selected contour. Let's take a quick look at what's here.
onboarding.slide.01.title: Welcome to the editor
onboarding.slide.02.text: Drag your finger or stylus across the canvas to draw. Some brushes respond to stylus pressure — press harder for a thicker stroke.
onboarding.slide.02.title: Draw your way
onboarding.slide.03.text: Tap the tools icon at the bottom to choose a brush — from classic round to a fine liner. Pick the right one for your task.
onboarding.slide.03.title: Different brush styles
onboarding.slide.04.text: Top of the left panel — switch between brush and eraser. The eraser only removes your strokes, the contour stays untouched.
onboarding.slide.04.title: Brush and eraser
onboarding.slide.05.text: Two sliders under the brush: top one for size, bottom one for opacity. Drag up or down to adjust.
onboarding.slide.05.title: Size and opacity
onboarding.slide.06.text: Use two fingers to zoom and pan. If you get lost — tap the reset icon, and the canvas returns to its original position.
onboarding.slide.06.title: Zoom and pan
onboarding.slide.07.text: Undo and Redo buttons at the bottom left. You can undo up to 5 steps and redo them back.
onboarding.slide.07.title: Made a mistake? No worries
onboarding.slide.08.text: Tap the color circle in the bottom panel to open the palette. Pick any hue, adjust opacity, or enter a HEX code. The eyedropper tool lets you grab a color directly from the canvas.
onboarding.slide.08.title: Brush color
onboarding.slide.09.text: You can change the color and opacity of the outline. Make it lighter if it's distracting, or change the color for a different look.
onboarding.slide.09.title: Adjust the contour
onboarding.slide.10.text: Tap Share in the top-right to save your artwork or send it to friends. And if you ever forget how something works — tap the ⓘ icon next to Share to see this guide again.
onboarding.slide.10.title: Save and share
